en.headline: Council lets Central fertility centre resume all licensed services
en.dek: HEAL Fertility may offer all 17 licensed treatments from Tuesday after inspectors accepted its remedial steps, the Department of Health said.
body: The Council on Human Reproductive Technology has approved HEAL Fertility, a Central day centre, to resume all 17 treatments covered by its licence from Tuesday, RTHK reported. The Department of Health said it was lifting an earlier direction that stopped the centre taking new reproductive-technology cases, after the Council confirmed the remedial and improvement measures had been properly put in place.

The centre was told in July to suspend 14 of those treatments after a mix-up of embryo-biopsy samples, and was required to carry out improvements. The Council met on Monday to consider the licence. It said an unannounced inspection had satisfied it that the centre had revised internal sample-handling procedures, strengthened staff training, installed closed-circuit television and a biometric authentication system in the laboratory, and improved sample identification. The main staff member involved had left, the Council said.

The Council said it would keep monitoring the centre so people seeking reproductive-technology services could continue to receive safe care. It has already begun a review of the Code of Practice on Reproductive Technology and Embryo Research, covering incident reporting and the security and handling of biological samples, with a target of finishing next year.

The Department of Health said it completed its own investigation last month into the centre's failure to report a significant risk event within 24 hours under the Code of Practice for day procedure centres. The centre has since been told to report any such event within 24 hours. The department said regulatory action on a licensed private healthcare facility depends on the level of risk to patient safety.

zh.headline: 希愈生殖醫學中心明起可恢復全部持牌服務
zh.dek: 管理局信納補救措施後批准恢復17項治療，衞生署亦解除暫停接收新症的指令。
body: 香港電台報道，早前發生胚胎活檢組織樣本錯配的中環「希愈生殖醫學中心」，獲人類生殖科技管理局批准，由星期二起全面恢復牌照涵蓋的17項治療服務。衞生署表示，管理局確認中心已妥善落實補救及改善措施，署方因此解除早前暫停中心接收生殖科技程序新症的指令。
中心在7月被要求暫停其中14項治療，並落實改善措施。管理局星期一開會審議牌照事宜，指突擊實地視察後，信納中心已完善內部樣本處理流程、加強員工培訓，在實驗室加裝閉路電視及生物信息認證系統，並改善辨識樣本的系統。管理局說，主要涉事人員已離職。
管理局表示會繼續監察中心表現，以保障尋求生殖科技服務的人士。局方較早已展開《生殖科技及胚胎研究實務守則》檢討，重點包括事故通報機制，以及生物樣本的保安及處理安排，目標明年完成。
衞生署上月初已完成調查並公布，中心未有按日間醫療中心實務守則，在識別重要風險事件後24小時內呈報。中心其後已按指示修訂程序。署方說，持牌私營醫療機構違反守則時，會按對病人安全的風險級別採取相應規管行動。
